newsitem.title: USA: TCSI Corp sees Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: TCSI Corp sees Q3 loss.

text.p: TCSI Corp on Wednesday said it expects to report a loss for the third quarter ending in September.

In a statement issued after the market closed, the provider of software for the telecommunications industry said it also expects revenues for the third quarter to be below the $21.8 million reported in the second quarter.
Earlier, shares of TCSI fell sharply on concerns the company would fall short of Wall Street's expectations for the quarter. TCSI closed at 15-1/2, down 5-1/4 or 25.3 percent.
Analysts had expected TCSI to earn $0.14 a share in the quarter, according to First Call.

"This quarter has turned out to be a disappointment," said Roger Strauch, president and chief executive officer. "As previously indicated, the nature of our business is such that it is difficult to predict the size and timing of significant customer engagements and license fees."

"We recently determined that a number of agreements that we had anticipated to close during the quarter will likely not close by quarter-end," he added. "During the quarter, the company continued to invest significant amounts for the development, introduction, and marketing of new products, product enhancements, and services in anticipation of such orders."
TCSI reported profits of $2.1 million or $0.16 a share in the year ago quarter on revenues of $14.1 million.
